title: The heart's Dhikr
body:
Once, daily, you must listen to your heart’s Dhikr. When you listen, you can hear your heart saying: ‘Allah,
Allah...’. This is an important Wird, more important than the tongue’s Dhikr. This gives concentration to the
whole body. The best time to do this is after midnight, at Tahajjud. First pray two Rakaats, then sit and listen
to your heart’s Dhikr... Your concentration will grow from this point to where that Dhikr, the remembrance of
your Lord, will be with you 24 hours a day. I am giving you permission; it means to take that ‘electricity’ from
the center which the Grandsheikhs are opening for us. When my Grandsheikh gave me permission, he was
opening, from his heart to my heart, such a power.
01.04.1999
